name: FileCrypt
tagline: File Encrypt / Decrypt is a Secure file box you add to a Power Apps screen or form.
description: File Encrypt / Decrypt is a Secure file box you add to a Power Apps screen or form. It locks a file with a passphrase so only people who know the passphrase can open it, and unlocks it again with the same passphrase. Everything happens inside the user's browser: the file and the passphrase are never sent anywhere.
